thread:
marta: Pushing sparrow-lite-v2 (int8) canary to dedicated pool — seeing funcall parse failures on tool calls (~1.8% over last 30m). Samples look truncated/malformed at suffix.
sanjeev: can you paste a sample and canary id?
marta: canary-id=canary-523. example model output we got:
```
{"action": "search", "args": {"q": "foo"}, "metadata": [
  {"id":123}
 // missing closing ] and }
```
looks like streaming cut mid-array and there's a stray comment token from model instead of JSON.
kai: hmm. smells like interleaved kv-cache + streaming boundary problem we've seen with int8 tokenization jitter. can you mirror the request with debug headers?

marta: running mirror now with `X-Canary-Debug: full`. curl: 
`curl -H "X-Canary-Debug: full" -d @payload https://mirror.redwood/canary-523`
logs show two chunks: first chunk ends at `...}
` and client-side parser consumes it; second chunk later contains the final `]}`. parser errors.

canary-bot: alert: funcall_parse_error rate = 1.8% -> 2.9% over 10m for model=sparrow-lite-v2/int8. threshold breach: 0.5%.
sanjeev: possible mitigations:
- bump retry budget for canary toolcall routes (3 attempts, exp backoff 200ms->400ms)
- enable json-wrap preprocessor to buffer until balanced braces
- if needed, fallback canary to fp16 path while we root cause tokenization cutoff

marta: quick A/B: enabled json-wrap for the canary route for 30m. errors dropped to 0.3% but median latency increased ~45ms. quick metrics: `errors:[1.8,0.3], p50_latency_ms:[120,165]`

luis: cost/throughput impact if we keep json-wrap for production? can we scope to only funcall/tool routes? :thinking_face:
kai: recommend scope to funcall/tool routes only. root cause likely that int8 token boundaries occasionally produce early EOS/control tokens mid-stream causing chunking inconsistencies. attaching tokenized offsets sample: `tokens: [.., 502, 13, 2, 0, 7]` where `0` looks like a control introduced by quant pathway.
marta: plan: (1) enable json-wrap for toolcall routes in canary, (2) increase retry budget temporarily, (3) run 24h QA with schema-linting to capture regressions, (4) reproduce locally with int8 mirror and instrumented streaming. I'll open tickets.
sanjeev: assign owners: @kai take token analysis and local repro, @marta run the rollout + metrics, @luis update canary gating thresholds.
luis: ack — I'll set canary gating to max parse error 0.7% and notify infra to hold rollouts above that. :thumbsup:
marta: thanks. I'll post the bake ticket and attach logs + example payloads. Follow-up in ~2h with initial 4h metrics snapshot.
kai: small note — if json-wrap is too expensive we can implement a lightweight suffix-checker that only buffers when the last chunk ends on an open delimiter. less buffering, similar safety.
marta: good idea, can you prototype a suffix-checker? If it's cheap we can enable that instead of full wrap.
kai: will prototype today, pinging when ready.
canary-bot: note: automated rollback policy will trigger if parse_error_rate > 1.0% for 15m on production routes.
sanjeev: perfect — let's keep canary-only changes for now. thanks team.
